script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2.
If the register's 'weakness' is not arg1, then set the register's 'weakness' to arg1.
If the register's 'bpConfsIdx' is not arg2, then
  Reset the count "turnInCurrPhase".
  Set the register's 'bpConfsIdx' to arg2.
  Set the register's 'isActuateHaste' to false.
  Set the register's 'isActuateBliga' to false.
  The enemy cancels its cast.

script_hooks.logic:
Let v2 be the count "turnInCurrPhase".
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
If not the register's 'isActuateHaste', then
  Let v3 be not (the enemy → is-reflected or the enemy has the HASTE status).
  Let number be the numeric entry list at bpConfsIdx's 'turnsToActuateHaste' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
  If v3 and v2 is at least number, then return the id of the move labelled "haste" on the enemy.
If not the register's 'isActuateBliga', then
  If v2 is at least the numeric entry list at bpConfsIdx's 'turnsToActuateBliga' in the battle settings of the group of the enemy, then return the id of the move labelled "bliga" on the enemy.
Return a smart-weighted move of the enemy.

script_hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrPhase".
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_HASTE_DONE" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isActuateHaste' to true.
If condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_BLIGA_DONE" is up this frame, then set the register's 'isActuateBliga' to true.
Let weakness be the register's 'weakness'.
Let v2 be weakness.
If condition flag data at weakness is up this frame, then set v2 to if weakness is "FIRE" then "ICE" else "FIRE".
Otherwise, if condition flag "CONDITION_FLAG_TAG_ELEMENTS" is up this frame, then the enemy → register-interrupt-ability-by-tag with ("trine_spark", {isCounter: true}, {interruptCounter: true}).
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v3 be run helper.
If weakness is not v2 or bpConfsIdx is not v3, then
  Let paramSuffixNoMap be list at v3's 'paramSuffixNoMap'.
  Let paramIdBySuffixNo be the stat block of form paramSuffixNoMap at v2 on the enemy.
  The enemy changes to stat block paramIdBySuffixNo.
  Helper2 → call with (this state, v2, v3).
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let v4 be run helper3.
  The enemy uses v4.
